name: @pipeworx/mcp-url

tools.name: parse_url
tools.description: Parse a URL into its components (keyless, offline): protocol, host, hostname, port, path, query (as an object), fragment, origin, and any userinfo.

tools.name: build_url
tools.description: Build a URL string from components. Provide at least `hostname` (and optionally protocol, port, path, hash) plus a `query` object of key/value pairs.

query.description: Query parameters as an object, e.g. {"q":"cats","page":2}.

tools.name: parse_query
tools.description: Parse a query string (with or without a leading "?") into an object; repeated keys become arrays.

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-url forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the url pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
